# Copilot Instructions

- Keep changes small and focused.
- Add a regression test for every fixed bug.
- Do not disable or skip existing tests.
- Prefer the Go standard library unless a new dependency is clearly required.
- Document API changes in repository docs when they affect users.
- Never add secrets, tokens, credentials, or private keys to the repository.
- Report only checks that were actually run, with their real outcomes.
- Do not perform or request auto-merge.
